title: Searching in the Business Insights Admin Portal

blocks.text: To help you navigate faster, you can search for menus in the Business Insights Admin Portal. Search results include menus in the left-hand navigation (except for items in the Help menu) and do not include:

blocks.item: Hover over the Search icon in the navigation menu. The search field appears.
Enter your search text. The portal automatically activates the cursor in the search bar, so you don't need to click before typing.

blocks.text: The search provides auto-complete suggestions as you enter text.
